```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
```{r}
access_antibiotics <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(access_antibiotics))

ggplot(access_antibiotics, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) + 
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("DID (standardised comsumption)") +
  ggtitle("Rate of antibiotic use in hospitals (Defined Daily Doses per 1,000 inhabitants per day (DID))")
```
